name: progress
description: A progress band above the prompt: the active plan's slice, the last honest check or build gate, the forge review queue, and tallies of a decision worksheet and a specification catalogue

planDir.title: Plans folder
planDir.description: Folder of Markdown plans, each with a slice table (columns #, Slice, Status) and frontmatter; the plan whose frontmatter says status: active is the one shown.

plan.title: Single plan file
plan.description: One plan file to show instead of scanning the folder, for a project that keeps a single plan.

gatePattern.title: Gate commands
gatePattern.description: Regular expression for the Bash commands whose real outcome the band keeps as the last gate.

queueLabel.title: Review queue label
queueLabel.description: The forge label whose open issues are the review queue, listed with open pull requests.

forgeRepo.title: Forge repository
forgeRepo.description: owner/repo on the forge; empty reads it from the origin remote.

forgeHost.title: Forge host
forgeHost.description: The Forgejo host for fgj; empty reads it from the origin remote.

worksheet.title: Decision worksheet
worksheet.description: A JSON worksheet in the worksheet mod's shape; the band tallies its priorities, undecided rows and overrides of the proposals. Empty hides the tally.

worksheetLabel.title: Worksheet label
worksheetLabel.description: The word the band uses for the worksheet tally.

catalogue.title: Specification catalogue
catalogue.description: A catalogue JSON with specifications (path) and areas; the band tallies the specifications by their frontmatter status. Empty hides the tally.

catalogueLabel.title: Catalogue label
catalogueLabel.description: The word the band uses for the specification tally.
